statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0253 is fixed in lru 0.18.2. Vector 0.58.0 already depends on lru 0.18.2 directly, but aws-sdk-s3 and ratatui-core still resolve lru 0.16.4 in Cargo.lock, so a workspace-wide cargo update cannot unify on 0.18.2 yet. Remediation is blocked until aws-sdk-rust/smithy-rs and ratatui adopt lru 0.18.x.

RUSTSEC-2026-0253 is fixed in lru 0.18.2, but ztunnel inherits lru 0.16.x through pingora-pool's ^0.16 semver requirement. Cargo resolution rejects 0.18.2 and a [patch.crates-io] git override for 0.18.2 is not applied to the crate graph, so the image cannot adopt the patched release without upstream pingora-pool widening its lru constraint.
